route_title: 24-Layer Dual-Band Filter with Simulated Annealing and ±20% Perturbation
compilation_rationale: Bounded compile. Explicit 24-layer HfO2/SiO2 sequence on fused silica. Quarter-wave initialization scaled by +/-20%. Simulated annealing mapped to Adam per schema constraints. Dual-band objectives (max T in IR, max R in visible) score all stated operating conditions. Robustness uncertainty modeled as relative uniform 20%.
